favorite_meals.name: Chicken and Rice Bowl
favorite_meals.notes: Season chicken with garlic powder, paprika, salt. Serve over white rice with steamed broccoli. Simple and filling.

favorite_meals.name: Turkey Taco Bowls
favorite_meals.notes: Brown ground turkey with taco spices. Serve over rice with salsa, shredded cabbage, lime.

favorite_meals.name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
favorite_meals.notes: Season salmon with lemon, olive oil, salt. Roast asparagus alongside. Often paired with rice.

favorite_meals.name: Pasta with Turkey Meat Sauce
favorite_meals.notes: Ground turkey, canned tomatoes, garlic, Italian seasoning over whole wheat pasta. Add parmesan.

favorite_meals.name: Egg and Veggie Scramble
favorite_meals.notes: 4 eggs each with bell peppers, spinach, and whatever veggies are around. Add cottage cheese on the side for extra protein.

favorite_meals.name: Shrimp Stir Fry
favorite_meals.notes: Shrimp with broccoli, bell peppers, low-sodium soy sauce, garlic, ginger over white rice.

favorite_meals.name: Greek Chicken Bowls
favorite_meals.notes: Marinate chicken in lemon, olive oil, oregano, garlic. Serve over quinoa with cucumber, tomato, feta.

favorite_meals.name: Tuna Salad Wrap
favorite_meals.notes: StarKist tuna with Greek yogurt (instead of mayo), Dijon, celery. Serve on Dave's Killer Bread or in romaine cups.

favorite_meals.name: Cottage Cheese Bowl
favorite_meals.notes: Good Culture cottage cheese with cherry tomatoes, cucumber, everything bagel seasoning. Add hard-boiled eggs for more protein.

favorite_meals.name: Ground Beef Stir Fry
favorite_meals.notes: 93/7 ground beef with zucchini, bell peppers, soy sauce, garlic over white rice.

favorite_meals.name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
favorite_meals.notes: Ground or diced chicken with water chestnuts, hoisin, soy sauce in romaine cups.

favorite_meals.name: Sweet Potato and Turkey Hash
favorite_meals.notes: Diced sweet potato, ground turkey, bell peppers, spinach, eggs cracked in at the end.

variety_ideas.name: Teriyaki Salmon Bowl
variety_ideas.notes: Salmon glazed with teriyaki sauce over brown rice with edamame and cucumber

variety_ideas.name: Turkey Stuffed Bell Peppers
variety_ideas.notes: Ground turkey, rice, tomato, spices stuffed in peppers and baked

variety_ideas.name: Chicken Fajita Bowls
variety_ideas.notes: Sliced chicken breast with fajita veggies over rice or in corn tortillas

variety_ideas.name: Baked Cod with Roasted Veggies
variety_ideas.notes: Light white fish with Brussels sprouts or green beans, easy weeknight

variety_ideas.name: Turkey Meatballs with Zucchini Noodles
variety_ideas.notes: Lighter pasta-style dish, zucchini noodles or mix with whole wheat pasta

variety_ideas.name: Egg Fried Rice
variety_ideas.notes: Leftover rice, eggs, peas, soy sauce, sesame oil — fast and satisfying

variety_ideas.name: Sheet Pan Chicken and Veggies
variety_ideas.notes: Chicken thighs or breast with any vegetables, toss in olive oil and roast everything together

variety_ideas.name: Shrimp Tacos
variety_ideas.notes: Seasoned shrimp in corn tortillas with cabbage slaw, lime, hot sauce
